CREATE UNIQUE INDEX active_destinations ON mappings(catalog,path) WHERE active=1
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX api_playback_cache ON api_playback_jobs(profile,cache_key) WHERE state IN ('queued','running','ready')
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalog_identity_pin_unique_value ON catalog_identity_pins(namespace,value) WHERE value IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalog_metadata_one_legacy ON catalog_metadata_sources(item_id) WHERE source_kind='legacy_import'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX catalog_metadata_one_local ON catalog_metadata_sources(item_id) WHERE source_kind='local'
CREATE INDEX catalog_receipt_active_holds ON catalog_receipt_holds(catalog_id,host_namespace,operation_id) WHERE released_at_us IS NULL
CREATE INDEX catalog_search_alias_reverse ON catalog_logical_retirements(survivor_item_id,item_id) WHERE kind='merge'
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX enabled_rule_name ON processing_rules(profile,name) WHERE enabled=1
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX item_file_parts ON item_files(item_id,role,part) WHERE active=1 AND part IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX publication_mapping_source ON mappings(file_id,catalog,path) WHERE active=1
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX relationship_positions ON item_relationships(target_id,kind,position) WHERE active=1 AND position IS NOT NULL
CREATE TABLE api_audit(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, principal TEXT, action TEXT NOT NULL, resource TEXT, created_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch()))

CREATE TABLE api_events( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, profile TEXT NOT NULL, resource_type TEXT NOT NULL, resource_id TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch()) )
CREATE TABLE api_grants(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, principal TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES api_principals(id), definition TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)

CREATE TABLE api_logical_demands(principal TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES api_principals(id), idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES api_requests(id), PRIMARY KEY(principal,idempotency_key))

CREATE TABLE api_operations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL, recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processing_recipes(id), location TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id), enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)

CREATE TABLE api_playback_jobs( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), cache_key TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, recipe TEXT NOT NULL, tools TEXT NOT NULL, destination TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK(state IN ('queued','running','ready','failed','cancelled','stale')), directory_device INTEGER, directory_inode INTEGER, reserved_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, reservation_device INTEGER NOT NULL, segment_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, available_seconds REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, error TEXT, created_at REAL NOT NULL, updated_at REAL NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE api_playback_sessions( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), principal TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES api_principals(id), token_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES api_tokens(id), idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT REFERENCES api_playback_jobs(id), result TEXT, cancelled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at REAL NOT NULL, expires REAL NOT NULL, UNIQUE(principal,idempotency_key) )
CREATE TABLE api_principals(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)
CREATE TABLE api_private_files(path TEXT PRIMARY KEY, device INTEGER NOT NULL, inode INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE api_requests(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL, principal TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES api_principals(id), token_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES api_tokens(id), idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processing_jobs(id), state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', reserved_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, reservation_device INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch()), UNIQUE(principal,idempotency_key))
CREATE TABLE api_reservations(job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES processing_jobs(id), device INTEGER NOT NULL, bytes INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE api_snapshots(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, principal TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, ids TEXT NOT NULL, expires REAL NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE api_sources(profile TEXT NOT NULL, location TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id), PRIMARY KEY(profile,location))

CREATE TABLE api_tickets(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, digest TEXT NOT NULL, token_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES api_tokens(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), revision TEXT NOT NULL, expires REAL NOT NULL, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, remaining_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE api_tokens(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, principal TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES api_principals(id), digest TEXT NOT NULL, grants TEXT NOT NULL, expires REAL NOT NULL, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE api_webhooks( profile TEXT NOT NULL, destination_id TEXT NOT NULL, principal TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES api_principals(id), token_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES api_tokens(id), url TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES api_requests(id), PRIMARY KEY(profile,destination_id), FOREIGN KEY(profile,destination_id) REFERENCES notification_destinations(profile,id) )
CREATE TABLE api_worker_status(profile TEXT PRIMARY KEY, worker_pid INTEGER NOT NULL, capabilities TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at REAL NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE binding_volumes( profile TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, owner TEXT NOT NULL, volume_uuid TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,kind,owner), FOREIGN KEY(profile,kind,owner) REFERENCES bindings(profile,kind,owner) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE bindings( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('source','output')), owner TEXT NOT NULL, root TEXT NOT NULL, device INTEGER NOT NULL, inode INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,kind,owner), UNIQUE(profile,root))

CREATE TABLE catalog_binding_revisions ( binding_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_bindings(id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision >= 1), profile TEXT NOT NULL, file_id TEXT NOT NULL, file_revision TEXT NOT NULL, part INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(part)='integer' AND part BETWEEN 1 AND 4294967295), source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_kind IN ('whole_file','slice')), source_start_us INTEGER, source_end_us INTEGER, timeline_start_us INTEGER, timeline_end_us INTEGER, normalization_evidence_id TEXT REFERENCES catalog_identity_evidence(id), recorded_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recorded_at_us)='integer' AND recorded_at_us >= 0), command_catalog_id TEXT NOT NULL, command_host_namespace TEXT NOT NULL, command_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(binding_id,revision), CHECK((source_kind='whole_file' AND source_start_us IS NULL AND source_end_us IS NULL AND timeline_start_us IS NULL AND timeline_end_us IS NULL) OR (typeof(source_start_us)='integer' AND typeof(source_end_us)='integer' AND source_start_us >= 0 AND source_end_us > source_start_us AND (source_kind='slice' OR source_start_us=0))), CHECK((timeline_start_us IS NULL AND timeline_end_us IS NULL AND source_kind='whole_file') OR (typeof(timeline_start_us)='integer' AND typeof(timeline_end_us)='integer' AND timeline_start_us >= 0 AND timeline_end_us > timeline_start_us AND timeline_end_us-timeline_start_us=source_end_us-source_start_us)), FOREIGN KEY(profile,file_id,file_revision) REFERENCES catalog_exact_file_revisions(profile,file_id,revision), FOREIGN KEY(command_catalog_id,command_host_namespace,command_operation_id) REFERENCES catalog_command_receipts(catalog_id,host_namespace,operation_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_bindings ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_versions(id), association_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES item_files(id), UNIQUE(id,version_id) )

CREATE TABLE catalog_command_receipts ( catalog_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_state(catalog_id), host_namespace TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(host_namespace AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), operation_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(operation_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), contract_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(contract_version=1), canonicalization_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(canonicalization_version=1), payload_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(payload_digest)=64 AND payload_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), admission_incarnation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(admission_incarnation)=32 AND admission_incarnation NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), expected_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(expected_generation)='integer' AND expected_generation >= 0), committed_generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(committed_generation)='integer' AND committed_generation >= expected_generation), committed_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(committed_at_us)='integer' AND committed_at_us >= 0), retain_until_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(retain_until_us)='integer' AND retain_until_us >= committed_at_us), result_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(result_state IN ('full','expired')), result_json TEXT, expired_at_us INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(catalog_id,host_namespace,operation_id), CHECK((result_state='full' AND result_json IS NOT NULL AND json_valid(result_json) AND length(CAST(result_json AS BLOB)) <= 4194304 AND expired_at_us IS NULL) OR (result_state='expired' AND result_json IS NULL AND typeof(expired_at_us)='integer' AND expired_at_us >= retain_until_us)) )
CREATE TABLE catalog_commit_barrier(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id = 1))

CREATE TABLE catalog_entity_revisions ( entity_kind TEXT NOT NULL, entity_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(entity_key) AND json_type(entity_key)='array'), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision >= 1), deleted INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(deleted IN (0,1)), PRIMARY KEY(entity_kind,entity_key) )

CREATE TABLE catalog_exact_file_revisions ( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), revision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(revision AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), revision_contract_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision_contract_version=1), snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(snapshot_json) AND json_type(snapshot_json)='object'), captured_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(captured_at_us)='integer' AND captured_at_us >= 0), PRIMARY KEY(profile,file_id,revision) )

CREATE TABLE catalog_file_tag_suppressions ( subject_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'file' CHECK(subject_type='file'), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, tag_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision >= 1), PRIMARY KEY(file_id,tag_id), FOREIGN KEY(subject_type,file_id,tag_id,revision) REFERENCES catalog_tag_suppression_revisions(subject_type,subject_id,tag_id,revision) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_identity_evidence ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), basis TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(basis IN ('declared','verified','legacy_import')), evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(evidence_json) AND json_type(evidence_json)='object'), recorded_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recorded_at_us)='integer' AND recorded_at_us >= 0), UNIQUE(id,basis) )

CREATE TABLE catalog_identity_pin_revisions ( item_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(item_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), namespace TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(namespace AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision>=1), value TEXT CHECK(value IS NULL OR length(CAST(value AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1024), recorded_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recorded_at_us)='integer' AND recorded_at_us>=0), command_catalog_id TEXT NOT NULL, command_host_namespace TEXT NOT NULL, command_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(item_id,namespace,revision), FOREIGN KEY(item_id,namespace) REFERENCES catalog_identity_pins(item_id,namespace) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, FOREIGN KEY(command_catalog_id,command_host_namespace,command_operation_id) REFERENCES catalog_command_receipts(catalog_id,host_namespace,operation_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_identity_pins ( item_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(item_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), namespace TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(namespace AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), current_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(current_revision)='integer' AND current_revision>=1), value TEXT CHECK(value IS NULL OR length(CAST(value AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1024), PRIMARY KEY(item_id,namespace), FOREIGN KEY(item_id,namespace,current_revision) REFERENCES catalog_identity_pin_revisions(item_id,namespace,revision) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_item_tag_suppressions ( subject_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'item' CHECK(subject_type='item'), item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, tag_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision >= 1), PRIMARY KEY(item_id,tag_id), FOREIGN KEY(subject_type,item_id,tag_id,revision) REFERENCES catalog_tag_suppression_revisions(subject_type,subject_id,tag_id,revision) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_legacy_associations ( association_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, original_file_id TEXT NOT NULL, original_item_id TEXT NOT NULL, original_row_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(original_row_json) AND json_type(original_row_json)='object'), classification TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unclassified' CHECK(classification='unclassified') )

CREATE TABLE catalog_legacy_identity_evidence ( namespace TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL, provenance TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy_import' CHECK(provenance='legacy_import'), PRIMARY KEY(namespace,value,item_id) )
CREATE TABLE catalog_legacy_item_metadata ( item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, metadata_raw TEXT NOT NULL, provenance TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy_import' CHECK(provenance='legacy_import') )
CREATE TABLE catalog_link_modes( catalog TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES catalogs(id), mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('symlink','hardlink')))

CREATE TABLE catalog_logical_edit_permits ( operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, incarnation TEXT NOT NULL, barrier_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(barrier_id=1), FOREIGN KEY(barrier_id) REFERENCES catalog_commit_barrier(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_logical_retirements ( item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('merge','split')), survivor_item_id TEXT REFERENCES items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, children_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(children_json) AND json_type(children_json)='array'), reference_map_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(reference_map_json) AND json_type(reference_map_json)='object'), command_catalog_id TEXT NOT NULL, command_host_namespace TEXT NOT NULL, command_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recorded_at_us)='integer' AND recorded_at_us>=0), CHECK((kind='merge' AND survivor_item_id IS NOT NULL AND survivor_item_id!=item_id AND json_array_length(children_json)=0) OR (kind='split' AND survivor_item_id IS NULL AND json_array_length(children_json) BETWEEN 2 AND 16)), FOREIGN KEY(command_catalog_id,command_host_namespace,command_operation_id) REFERENCES catalog_command_receipts(catalog_id,host_namespace,operation_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_metadata_history ( item_id TEXT NOT NULL, namespace TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(namespace AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), record_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(record_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision>=1), source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_kind IN ('local','provider','scan','legacy_import')), schema_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, fields_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(fields_json) AND json_type(fields_json)='object' AND length(CAST(fields_json AS BLOB))<=65536), evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(evidence_json) AND json_type(evidence_json)='object' AND length(CAST(evidence_json AS BLOB))<=8192), raw_mutation_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(raw_mutation_json) AND json_type(raw_mutation_json)='object' AND length(CAST(raw_mutation_json AS BLOB))<=262144), command_catalog_id TEXT NOT NULL, command_host_namespace TEXT NOT NULL, command_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, admitted_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(admitted_at_us)='integer' AND admitted_at_us>=0), PRIMARY KEY(item_id,namespace,record_id,revision), FOREIGN KEY(item_id,schema_fingerprint) REFERENCES catalog_metadata_subjects(item_id,schema_fingerprint) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK(source_kind!='legacy_import' OR (namespace='catabolic.legacy_import.v1' AND record_id='items.metadata')), CHECK(namespace!='catabolic.legacy_import.v1' OR source_kind='legacy_import') )

CREATE TABLE catalog_metadata_permits ( item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, incarnation TEXT NOT NULL, barrier_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(barrier_id=1), FOREIGN KEY(barrier_id) REFERENCES catalog_commit_barrier(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_metadata_projection ( item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, schema_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, resolution_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(resolution_json) AND json_type(resolution_json)='object' AND length(CAST(resolution_json AS BLOB))<=8388608), effective_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(effective_json) AND json_type(effective_json)='object' AND length(CAST(effective_json AS BLOB))<=2097152), FOREIGN KEY(item_id,schema_fingerprint) REFERENCES catalog_metadata_subjects(item_id,schema_fingerprint) ON DELETE RESTRICT )

CREATE TABLE catalog_metadata_sources ( item_id TEXT NOT NULL, namespace TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(namespace AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), record_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(record_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_kind IN ('local','provider','scan','legacy_import')), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision>=1), schema_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, fields_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(fields_json) AND json_type(fields_json)='object' AND length(CAST(fields_json AS BLOB))<=65536), evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(evidence_json) AND json_type(evidence_json)='object' AND length(CAST(evidence_json AS BLOB))<=8192), PRIMARY KEY(item_id,namespace,record_id), FOREIGN KEY(item_id,schema_fingerprint) REFERENCES catalog_metadata_subjects(item_id,schema_fingerprint) ON DELETE RESTRICT, FOREIGN KEY(item_id,namespace,record_id,revision) REFERENCES catalog_metadata_history(item_id,namespace,record_id,revision) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK(source_kind!='legacy_import' OR (namespace='catabolic.legacy_import.v1' AND record_id='items.metadata')), CHECK(namespace!='catabolic.legacy_import.v1' OR source_kind='legacy_import') )

CREATE TABLE catalog_metadata_subjects ( item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, contract_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(contract_version=1), schema_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(schema_fingerprint)=64 AND schema_fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), policies_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(policies_json) AND json_type(policies_json)='array' AND json_array_length(policies_json) BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND length(CAST(policies_json AS BLOB))<=32768), legacy_raw_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(legacy_raw_json) AND json_type(legacy_raw_json)='object' AND length(CAST(legacy_raw_json AS BLOB))<=65536), command_catalog_id TEXT NOT NULL, command_host_namespace TEXT NOT NULL, command_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, admitted_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(admitted_at_us)='integer' AND admitted_at_us>=0), UNIQUE(item_id,schema_fingerprint) )

CREATE TABLE catalog_mutation_permits ( scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope_kind IN ('version','context','timeline','restore')), scope_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(scope_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), incarnation TEXT NOT NULL, barrier_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(barrier_id = 1), PRIMARY KEY(scope_kind,scope_id), FOREIGN KEY(barrier_id) REFERENCES catalog_commit_barrier(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_receipt_holds ( catalog_id TEXT NOT NULL, host_namespace TEXT NOT NULL, operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, holder_namespace TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(holder_namespace AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), hold_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(hold_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), acquired_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(acquired_at_us)='integer' AND acquired_at_us >= 0), released_at_us INTEGER CHECK(released_at_us IS NULL OR (typeof(released_at_us)='integer' AND released_at_us >= acquired_at_us)), PRIMARY KEY(catalog_id,host_namespace,operation_id,holder_namespace,hold_id), FOREIGN KEY(catalog_id,host_namespace,operation_id) REFERENCES catalog_command_receipts(catalog_id,host_namespace,operation_id) )

CREATE TABLE catalog_refresh_queue( profile TEXT NOT NULL, catalog TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, next_attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, error TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY(profile,catalog), FOREIGN KEY(profile,catalog) REFERENCES catalog_refresh_settings(profile,catalog))

CREATE TABLE catalog_refresh_settings( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), catalog TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogs(id), enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)), max_removals INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(max_removals>=0), PRIMARY KEY(profile,catalog))

CREATE TABLE catalog_search_dirty( item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, barrier_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(barrier_id=1), FOREIGN KEY(barrier_id) REFERENCES catalog_commit_barrier(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_search_documents( rowid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, item_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, title TEXT NOT NULL, aliases TEXT NOT NULL, accepted_identities TEXT NOT NULL, effective_tags TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL )

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE catalog_search_fts USING fts5( title, aliases, accepted_identities, effective_tags, description, content='catalog_search_documents',content_rowid='rowid', tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2' )
CREATE TABLE 'catalog_search_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE 'catalog_search_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'catalog_search_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'catalog_search_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE catalog_search_state( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), contract_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(contract_version=1), tokenizer TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(tokenizer='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2'), extractor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(extractor='native-search-values-v1'), ready INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ready IN (0,1)), input_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(input_revision)='integer' AND input_revision>=0), indexed_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(indexed_revision)='integer' AND indexed_revision>=0 AND indexed_revision<=input_revision), catalog_id TEXT, incarnation TEXT, rebuilt_generation INTEGER, CHECK(ready=0 OR (catalog_id IS NOT NULL AND incarnation IS NOT NULL AND rebuilt_generation IS NOT NULL)) )

CREATE TABLE catalog_search_values( item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, field_key TEXT NOT NULL, origin_key TEXT NOT NULL, rank_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(rank_class IN ('title','aliases','accepted_identities','effective_tags','description')), value_text TEXT NOT NULL, provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(provenance_json) AND json_type(provenance_json)='object'), required_subjects_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(required_subjects_json) AND json_type(required_subjects_json)='array'), PRIMARY KEY(item_id,field_key,origin_key) )

CREATE TABLE catalog_segment_members ( context_id TEXT NOT NULL, context_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, set_id TEXT NOT NULL, binding_id TEXT NOT NULL, binding_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(context_id,context_revision,binding_id), FOREIGN KEY(context_id,context_revision) REFERENCES catalog_segmentation_revisions(context_id,revision), FOREIGN KEY(set_id,context_id) REFERENCES catalog_segmentation_sets(id,context_id), FOREIGN KEY(binding_id,binding_revision) REFERENCES catalog_binding_revisions(binding_id,revision) )

CREATE TABLE catalog_segmentation_contexts ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), authority_namespace TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(authority_namespace AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), context_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(context_key AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), current_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(current_revision)='integer' AND current_revision >= 1), UNIQUE(authority_namespace,context_key), FOREIGN KEY(id,current_revision) REFERENCES catalog_segmentation_revisions(context_id,revision) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_segmentation_revisions ( context_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_segmentation_contexts(id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision >= 1), recorded_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recorded_at_us)='integer' AND recorded_at_us >= 0), command_catalog_id TEXT NOT NULL, command_host_namespace TEXT NOT NULL, command_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(context_id,revision), FOREIGN KEY(command_catalog_id,command_host_namespace,command_operation_id) REFERENCES catalog_command_receipts(catalog_id,host_namespace,operation_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_segmentation_sets ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), context_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_segmentation_contexts(id), profile TEXT NOT NULL, file_id TEXT NOT NULL, file_revision TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(context_id,profile,file_id,file_revision), UNIQUE(id,context_id), FOREIGN KEY(profile,file_id,file_revision) REFERENCES catalog_exact_file_revisions(profile,file_id,revision) )

CREATE TABLE catalog_state ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id = 1), catalog_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(CAST(catalog_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), incarnation TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(incarnation)=32 AND incarnation NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(generation) = 'integer' AND generation >= 0), contract_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(contract_version = 1) )

CREATE TABLE catalog_tag_merges ( source_tag_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(source_tag_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), original_target_tag_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(original_target_tag_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(snapshot_json) AND json_type(snapshot_json)='object' AND length(CAST(snapshot_json AS BLOB)) <= 2097152), recorded_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recorded_at_us)='integer' AND recorded_at_us >= 0), command_catalog_id TEXT NOT NULL, command_host_namespace TEXT NOT NULL, command_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(source_tag_id != original_target_tag_id), FOREIGN KEY(command_catalog_id,command_host_namespace,command_operation_id) REFERENCES catalog_command_receipts(catalog_id,host_namespace,operation_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_tag_redirects ( source_tag_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_tag_merges(source_tag_id), target_tag_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id), CHECK(source_tag_id != target_tag_id) )

CREATE TABLE catalog_tag_suppression_revisions ( subject_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(subject_type IN ('item','file')), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(subject_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), tag_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(tag_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision >= 1), suppressed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(suppressed IN (0,1)), reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(reason AS BLOB)) <= 4000), recorded_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recorded_at_us)='integer' AND recorded_at_us >= 0), command_catalog_id TEXT NOT NULL, command_host_namespace TEXT NOT NULL, command_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(subject_type,subject_id,tag_id,revision), FOREIGN KEY(command_catalog_id,command_host_namespace,command_operation_id) REFERENCES catalog_command_receipts(catalog_id,host_namespace,operation_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_timeline_revisions ( timeline_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_timelines(id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision >= 1), identity_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(identity_state IN ('provisional','established')), coverage_start_us INTEGER, coverage_end_us INTEGER, recorded_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recorded_at_us)='integer' AND recorded_at_us >= 0), command_catalog_id TEXT NOT NULL, command_host_namespace TEXT NOT NULL, command_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(timeline_id,revision), CHECK((coverage_start_us IS NULL AND coverage_end_us IS NULL) OR (typeof(coverage_start_us)='integer' AND typeof(coverage_end_us)='integer' AND coverage_start_us >= 0 AND coverage_end_us > coverage_start_us)), FOREIGN KEY(command_catalog_id,command_host_namespace,command_operation_id) REFERENCES catalog_command_receipts(catalog_id,host_namespace,operation_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_timelines ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), edition_item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), current_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(current_revision)='integer' AND current_revision >= 1), FOREIGN KEY(id,current_revision) REFERENCES catalog_timeline_revisions(timeline_id,revision) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_version_bindings ( version_id TEXT NOT NULL, version_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, binding_id TEXT NOT NULL, binding_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(version_id,version_revision,binding_id), FOREIGN KEY(version_id,version_revision) REFERENCES catalog_version_revisions(version_id,revision), FOREIGN KEY(binding_id,binding_revision) REFERENCES catalog_binding_revisions(binding_id,revision), FOREIGN KEY(binding_id,version_id) REFERENCES catalog_bindings(id,version_id) )

CREATE TABLE catalog_version_retirements ( version_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES catalog_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, version_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(version_revision)='integer' AND version_revision>=1), command_catalog_id TEXT NOT NULL, command_host_namespace TEXT NOT NULL, command_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recorded_at_us)='integer' AND recorded_at_us>=0), FOREIGN KEY(version_id,version_revision) REFERENCES catalog_version_revisions(version_id,revision), FOREIGN KEY(command_catalog_id,command_host_namespace,command_operation_id) REFERENCES catalog_command_receipts(catalog_id,host_namespace,operation_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_version_revisions ( version_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_versions(id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision >= 1), timeline_id TEXT NOT NULL, timeline_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(timeline_revision)='integer' AND timeline_revision >= 1), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('draft','ready')), coverage_start_us INTEGER, coverage_end_us INTEGER, equivalence_evidence_id TEXT, equivalence_basis TEXT CHECK(equivalence_basis IN ('declared','verified')), recorded_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(recorded_at_us)='integer' AND recorded_at_us >= 0), command_catalog_id TEXT NOT NULL, command_host_namespace TEXT NOT NULL, command_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(version_id,revision), CHECK((coverage_start_us IS NULL AND coverage_end_us IS NULL AND state='draft') OR (typeof(coverage_start_us)='integer' AND typeof(coverage_end_us)='integer' AND coverage_start_us >= 0 AND coverage_end_us > coverage_start_us)), CHECK((equivalence_evidence_id IS NULL AND equivalence_basis IS NULL) OR (equivalence_evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND equivalence_basis IS NOT NULL)), FOREIGN KEY(timeline_id,timeline_revision) REFERENCES catalog_timeline_revisions(timeline_id,revision), FOREIGN KEY(equivalence_evidence_id,equivalence_basis) REFERENCES catalog_identity_evidence(id,basis), FOREIGN KEY(command_catalog_id,command_host_namespace,command_operation_id) REFERENCES catalog_command_receipts(catalog_id,host_namespace,operation_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )

CREATE TABLE catalog_versions ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 256), association_item_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES items(id), segmentation_context_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_segmentation_contexts(id), current_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(current_revision)='integer' AND current_revision >= 1), FOREIGN KEY(id,current_revision) REFERENCES catalog_version_revisions(version_id,revision) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED )
CREATE TABLE catalogs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

CREATE TABLE component_assertions ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES proposals(id), occurrence_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES component_occurrences(id), component_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES media_components(id), payload TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)) )

CREATE TABLE component_job_inputs ( job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processing_jobs(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES component_occurrences(id), evidence TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(job_id,ordinal) )

CREATE TABLE component_occurrences ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, component_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES media_components(id), profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), association_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES item_files(id), item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), revision TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, association_evidence TEXT NOT NULL, item_evidence TEXT NOT NULL, storage TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(storage IN ('embedded','external')), locator TEXT NOT NULL, probe_job_id TEXT REFERENCES processing_jobs(id), stream_key INTEGER, probe_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

CREATE TABLE component_output_lineage ( artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processing_artifacts(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, occurrence_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES component_occurrences(id), output_stream_index INTEGER NOT NULL, relationship TEXT NOT NULL, component_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES media_components(id), PRIMARY KEY(artifact_id,ordinal) )

CREATE TABLE consumer_attempts( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL, group_id TEXT NOT NULL, token TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, started_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, finished_at TEXT, error TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(profile,group_id) REFERENCES consumer_deliveries(profile,id))

CREATE TABLE consumer_bindings( profile TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, connection_id TEXT NOT NULL, catalog TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogs(id), subtree TEXT NOT NULL, remote_root TEXT NOT NULL, local_binding TEXT NOT NULL, library TEXT NOT NULL, group_id TEXT NOT NULL, origin TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)), automatic INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(automatic IN (0,1)), debounce INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(debounce BETWEEN 0 AND 3600), revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, verified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, acknowledged INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, due_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, verified_at TEXT, error TEXT, indexing TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(profile,id), FOREIGN KEY(profile,connection_id) REFERENCES consumer_connections(profile,id))

CREATE TABLE consumer_connections( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), id TEXT NOT NULL, application TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(application IN ('plex','jellyfin')), endpoint TEXT NOT NULL, credential_env TEXT NOT NULL, server_id TEXT NOT NULL, evidence TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY(profile,id))

CREATE TABLE consumer_creations( profile TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, connection_id TEXT NOT NULL, connection_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, spec TEXT NOT NULL, before_ids TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, library TEXT, error TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY(profile,id), FOREIGN KEY(profile,connection_id) REFERENCES consumer_connections(profile,id))

CREATE TABLE consumer_deliveries( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), id TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, due_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, lease_token TEXT, lease_until REAL, error TEXT, accepted_at TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(profile,id))

CREATE TABLE consumer_events( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), event TEXT NOT NULL, severity TEXT NOT NULL, subject TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE content_baselines( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), algorithm TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, size INTEGER NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processing_jobs(id), PRIMARY KEY(profile,file_id,algorithm))
CREATE TABLE copy_policies( catalog TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES catalogs(id), definition TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE decision_events( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES proposals(id), action TEXT NOT NULL, actor TEXT NOT NULL, before_value TEXT NOT NULL, after_value TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE execution_claims( job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES processing_jobs(id), generation INTEGER NOT NULL, token TEXT NOT NULL, worker_pid INTEGER NOT NULL, attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, lease_until REAL NOT NULL, snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, options TEXT NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE expected_sets( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, collection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), source TEXT NOT NULL, edition TEXT NOT NULL, ordering TEXT NOT NULL, complete INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(complete IN (0,1)), members TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE external_receipts( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), producer TEXT NOT NULL, instance TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL, attempt TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(profile,producer,instance,job_id,attempt))

CREATE TABLE fallback_bindings( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), catalog TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogs(id), policy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fallback_policies(id), query_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES saved_queries(id), layout TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, interval_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 60, max_changes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100, max_removals INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, next_attempt REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(profile,catalog))
CREATE TABLE fallback_dependencies(policy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fallback_policies(id), query_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES saved_queries(id), PRIMARY KEY(policy_id,query_id))

CREATE TABLE fallback_entries( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL, catalog TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), role TEXT NOT NULL, part INTEGER, variant TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', policy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES fallback_policies(id), file_id TEXT REFERENCES files(id), revision TEXT, tier INTEGER, tier_name TEXT, path TEXT, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, state TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, published_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, evidence TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', FOREIGN KEY(profile,catalog) REFERENCES fallback_bindings(profile,catalog))
CREATE TABLE fallback_epoch(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), generation INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE fallback_health(profile TEXT NOT NULL, catalog TEXT NOT NULL, entry_id TEXT NOT NULL, file_id TEXT NOT NULL, revision TEXT NOT NULL, healthy_since REAL NOT NULL, successes INTEGER NOT NULL, last_check REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,catalog,entry_id,file_id))

CREATE TABLE fallback_history(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, profile TEXT NOT NULL, catalog TEXT NOT NULL, entry_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, decision TEXT NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE fallback_policies( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), name TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, definition TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(profile,name,revision), UNIQUE(profile,name,digest))
CREATE TABLE fallback_probe_slots(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT, pid INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE file_facts( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), operation TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processing_jobs(id), snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,file_id,operation))

CREATE TABLE file_tags( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), tag_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id), source TEXT NOT NULL, confidence REAL CHECK(confidence IS NULL OR (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1)), note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN (0,1)), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(file_id,tag_id,source))
CREATE TABLE files( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, location TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id), path TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(location,path))
CREATE TABLE generated_locations( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), location TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id), PRIMARY KEY(profile,location))
CREATE TABLE http_mapping_definitions( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), id TEXT NOT NULL, definition TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,id) )

CREATE TABLE http_mapping_deliveries( event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES consumer_events(id), operation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES http_operations(id), mapping_id TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL, plan_id TEXT NOT NULL, request TEXT NOT NULL, token_id TEXT REFERENCES api_tokens(id) )

CREATE TABLE http_mapping_ledger( profile TEXT NOT NULL, mapping_id TEXT NOT NULL, key TEXT NOT NULL, request_digest TEXT NOT NULL, event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES consumer_events(id), PRIMARY KEY(profile,mapping_id,key), FOREIGN KEY(profile,mapping_id) REFERENCES http_mapping_definitions(profile,id) )

CREATE TABLE http_operations( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), name TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, definition TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, principal TEXT REFERENCES api_principals(id), token_id TEXT REFERENCES api_tokens(id), UNIQUE(profile,name,digest) )
CREATE TABLE identities( namespace TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL, item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), PRIMARY KEY(namespace,value))

CREATE TABLE item_files( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), role TEXT NOT NULL, part INTEGER CHECK(part IS NULL OR part > 0), metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(origin IN ('explicit','mapping','migration')), active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)), UNIQUE(file_id,item_id,role))

CREATE TABLE item_relationships( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), target_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL, position INTEGER CHECK(position IS NULL OR position > 0), metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)), CHECK(source_id != target_id), UNIQUE(source_id,target_id,kind))

CREATE TABLE item_requirements( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('review','file','job','artifact','proposal')), label TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','complete','waived')), file_id TEXT REFERENCES files(id), job_id TEXT REFERENCES processing_jobs(id), artifact_id TEXT REFERENCES processing_artifacts(id), proposal_id TEXT REFERENCES proposals(id), CHECK((kind='review' AND file_id IS NULL AND job_id IS NULL AND artifact_id IS NULL AND proposal_id IS NULL) OR (kind='file' AND file_id IS NOT NULL AND job_id IS NULL AND artifact_id IS NULL AND proposal_id IS NULL) OR (kind='job' AND file_id IS NULL AND job_id IS NOT NULL AND artifact_id IS NULL AND proposal_id IS NULL) OR (kind='artifact' AND file_id IS NULL AND job_id IS NULL AND artifact_id IS NOT NULL AND proposal_id IS NULL) OR (kind='proposal' AND file_id IS NULL AND job_id IS NULL AND artifact_id IS NULL AND proposal_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK(kind='review' OR state!='complete'))

CREATE TABLE item_tags( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), tag_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id), source TEXT NOT NULL, confidence REAL CHECK(confidence IS NULL OR (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1)), note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN (0,1)), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(item_id,tag_id,source))

CREATE TABLE item_workflow( item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES items(id), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending','in_progress','complete','deferred','ignored')), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE item_worklog( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('note','decision','progress','status','requirement')), body TEXT NOT NULL, actor TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(item_id,revision))
CREATE TABLE items(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, metadata TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE journal( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL, catalog TEXT NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT, previous TEXT, UNIQUE(profile,catalog,path))
CREATE TABLE locations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

CREATE TABLE mappings( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, catalog TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogs(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), path TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)
CREATE TABLE media_components ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(kind IN ('video','audio','subtitle','attachment')) )

CREATE TABLE media_header_checks( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), scan_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scans(id), size INTEGER NOT NULL, mtime_ns INTEGER NOT NULL, device INTEGER NOT NULL, inode INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('invalid','not_detected','unknown')), reason TEXT, bytes_read INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,file_id) )

CREATE TABLE media_outputs( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), source_file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), source_item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), definition_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES output_definitions(id), artifact_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES processing_artifacts(id), origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(origin IN ('generated','registered')), metadata TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(profile,file_id), CHECK(file_id!=source_file_id), CHECK((origin='generated' AND artifact_id IS NOT NULL) OR (origin='registered' AND artifact_id IS NULL)))
CREATE TABLE meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE notification_deliveries( event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES consumer_events(id), profile TEXT NOT NULL, destination_id TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, due_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, lease_token TEXT, lease_until REAL, error TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(event_id,profile,destination_id), FOREIGN KEY(profile,destination_id) REFERENCES notification_destinations(profile,id))

CREATE TABLE notification_destinations( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), id TEXT NOT NULL, credential_env TEXT NOT NULL, subscriptions TEXT NOT NULL, tags TEXT NOT NULL, min_severity TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY(profile,id))

CREATE TABLE observation_batches ( job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES observation_jobs(id), sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, observed INTEGER NOT NULL, bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, committed_at REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(job_id,sequence) )

CREATE TABLE observation_jobs ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, compatibility TEXT NOT NULL, exclusions TEXT NOT NULL, dirty_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('queued','running','complete','unavailable','failed','stale')), requested_at REAL NOT NULL, started_at REAL, completed_at REAL, lease_until REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, worker_pid INTEGER, scan_id TEXT, report TEXT, guarded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, execution TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', parent_job TEXT REFERENCES observation_jobs(id), claim_token TEXT, UNIQUE(profile,source,generation) )

CREATE TABLE observation_requests ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, requester TEXT, guarantees TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES observation_jobs(id), state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(state IN ('active','cancelled')), created_at REAL NOT NULL, UNIQUE(profile,source,requester) )

CREATE TABLE observation_scopes ( job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES observation_jobs(id), path TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', updated_at REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(job_id,path) )
CREATE TABLE observation_seen ( job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES observation_jobs(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(job_id,file_id) )
CREATE TABLE observation_sources ( profile TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, dirty_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(profile,source) )

CREATE TABLE observations( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), size INTEGER NOT NULL, mtime_ns INTEGER NOT NULL, device INTEGER NOT NULL, inode INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('present','missing')), scan_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scans(id), PRIMARY KEY(profile,file_id))

CREATE TABLE output_definitions( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0), definition TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(name,revision), UNIQUE(name,digest))

CREATE TABLE owned_hardlinks( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), catalog TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogs(id), path TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,catalog,path))
CREATE TABLE owned_links( profile TEXT NOT NULL, catalog TEXT NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,catalog,path))

CREATE TABLE processing_artifacts( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processing_jobs(id), attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt>0), profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), location TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id), path TEXT NOT NULL, temporary_path TEXT NOT NULL, binding TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('planned','writing','validating','publishing','ready','failed','interrupted')), file_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES files(id), item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), role TEXT NOT NULL, size INTEGER, sha256 TEXT, validation TEXT, device INTEGER, inode INTEGER, error TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, publication_snapshot TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(job_id,attempt) REFERENCES processing_attempts(job_id,attempt), FOREIGN KEY(profile,location) REFERENCES generated_locations(profile,location), UNIQUE(job_id,attempt), UNIQUE(location,path), UNIQUE(location,temporary_path), CHECK(state!='ready' OR (file_id IS NOT NULL AND sha256 IS NOT NULL AND size>0)))

CREATE TABLE processing_attempts( job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processing_jobs(id), attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt > 0), state TEXT NOT NULL, error TEXT, retryable INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(retryable IN (0,1)), retry_after REAL NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, started_at TEXT, finished_at TEXT, result TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(job_id,attempt))

CREATE TABLE processing_jobs( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), operation TEXT NOT NULL, location TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id), snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, options TEXT NOT NULL, cache_key TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, result TEXT, error TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, finished_at TEXT, recipe_id TEXT REFERENCES processing_recipes(id))

CREATE TABLE processing_recipes( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0), preset TEXT NOT NULL, definition TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, output_definition_id TEXT REFERENCES output_definitions(id), operation_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'render' CHECK(operation_kind IN ('render','analysis','external')), UNIQUE(name,revision), UNIQUE(name,digest))
CREATE TABLE processing_retry_queue( job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES processing_jobs(id), profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, retry_after REAL NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE "processing_rules"( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), name TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0), recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processing_recipes(id), location TEXT REFERENCES locations(id), selection TEXT NOT NULL, estimate_options TEXT NOT NULL, required INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(required IN (0,1)), enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)), digest TEXT NOT NULL, allow_derived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(allow_derived IN (0,1)), query_id TEXT REFERENCES saved_queries(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(profile,name,revision), UNIQUE(profile,name,digest), FOREIGN KEY(profile,location) REFERENCES generated_locations(profile,location))

CREATE TABLE processor_attempts( job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processor_jobs(id), generation INTEGER NOT NULL, worker TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, started_at INTEGER NOT NULL, finished_at INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(job_id,generation))

CREATE TABLE processor_jobs( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), processor TEXT NOT NULL, request TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK(state IN ('queued','leased','submitted','complete','failed','cancelled')), generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, worker TEXT, lease_token TEXT, lease_until INTEGER, receipt_id TEXT REFERENCES external_receipts(id), error TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, operation_id TEXT REFERENCES processing_recipes(id), UNIQUE(profile,processor,digest), FOREIGN KEY(profile,processor) REFERENCES processors(profile,id))
CREATE TABLE processors( id TEXT NOT NULL, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), definition TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,id))
CREATE TABLE profiles(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

CREATE TABLE projection_bindings( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), catalog TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogs(id), query_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES saved_queries(id), layout TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,catalog))

CREATE TABLE proposals( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, evidence TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN ('pending','accepted','rejected')), result TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE publication_generations( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), catalog TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogs(id), local_binding TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, verified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, verified_at TEXT, last_checked REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(profile,catalog))

CREATE TABLE query_dependencies( query_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES saved_queries(id), dependency_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES saved_queries(id), PRIMARY KEY(query_id,dependency_id), CHECK(query_id!=dependency_id))

CREATE TABLE receipt_outputs( receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES external_receipts(id), output_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES media_outputs(id), snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(receipt_id,output_id))
CREATE TABLE refresh_dirty( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), catalog TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogs(id), target TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,catalog))

CREATE TABLE refresh_events( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), catalog TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogs(id), target TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, error TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, finished_at TEXT, lease_token TEXT, lease_until REAL)

CREATE TABLE refresh_targets( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), catalog TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogs(id), application TEXT NOT NULL, endpoint TEXT NOT NULL, credential_env TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,catalog))
CREATE TABLE remount_guard(profile TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES profiles(id))
CREATE TABLE remount_repairs( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), plan TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE rendition_decisions( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), catalog TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogs(id), output_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES media_outputs(id), excluded INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(excluded IN (0,1)), reason TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,catalog,output_id))

CREATE TABLE rendition_policies( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), catalog TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogs(id), definition TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,catalog))

CREATE TABLE retained_hardlinks( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), catalog TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalogs(id), path TEXT NOT NULL, original_path TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL, retained_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(profile,catalog,path))

CREATE TABLE rule_evaluations( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, rule_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processing_rules(id), matched_inputs INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(matched_inputs>=0), counts TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE "rule_jobs"( rule_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processing_rules(id), job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processing_jobs(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), item_id TEXT REFERENCES items(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY(rule_id,job_id))

CREATE TABLE rule_processor_jobs( rule_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processing_rules(id), job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processor_jobs(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY(rule_id,job_id))

CREATE TABLE rule_requirements( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, rule_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processing_rules(id), profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), item_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id), evaluation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rule_evaluations(id), job_id TEXT REFERENCES processing_jobs(id), state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN ('pending','waived')), processor_job_id TEXT REFERENCES processor_jobs(id), UNIQUE(rule_id,file_id,item_id))

CREATE TABLE saved_queries( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), name TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0), definition TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(profile,name,revision), UNIQUE(profile,name,digest))

CREATE TABLE scans( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL, location TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id), complete INTEGER NOT NULL, observed INTEGER NOT NULL, errors TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE schema_migrations ( version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, filename TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, checksum TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(checksum) = 64), origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(origin IN ('initialized', 'baseline', 'migrated')), applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')) )

CREATE TABLE source_identity_policies( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), location TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id), identity_policy TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(identity_policy IN ('strict','path')), settings TEXT, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY(profile,location))
CREATE TABLE source_observation_policies ( profile TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, policy TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,source) )

CREATE TABLE source_observation_policy_history ( profile TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, policy TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY(profile,source,revision) )

CREATE TABLE source_policy_history( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), location TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL, settings TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UNIQUE(profile,location,revision))
CREATE TABLE tag_names( name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tag_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id))
CREATE TABLE tag_parents( child_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id), parent_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id), CHECK(child_id != parent_id), PRIMARY KEY(child_id,parent_id))
CREATE TABLE tags( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE text_segments( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES processing_jobs(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, locator TEXT NOT NULL, text TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(profile,file_id,ordinal))
CREATE TABLE text_terms( term TEXT NOT NULL, segment_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES text_segments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY(term,segment_id))

CREATE TABLE watch_revisions( profile TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), file_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id), revision TEXT NOT NULL, stable_since REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,file_id))

CREATE TABLE watcher_definitions ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, definition TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, created_at REAL NOT NULL, UNIQUE(profile,name,revision), UNIQUE(profile,name,digest) )
CREATE TABLE watcher_owners ( profile TEXT NOT NULL, catalog TEXT NOT NULL, watcher TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,catalog), FOREIGN KEY(profile,watcher) REFERENCES watchers(profile,name) )

CREATE TABLE watcher_runs ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile TEXT NOT NULL, watcher TEXT NOT NULL, definition_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, trigger TEXT NOT NULL, scheduled_at REAL NOT NULL, started_at REAL NOT NULL, completed_at REAL, state TEXT NOT NULL, worker_pid INTEGER, result TEXT, error TEXT )

CREATE TABLE watchers ( profile TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, definition_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES watcher_definitions(id), enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pending_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, completed_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, requested_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, next_due REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, retry_at REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, active_run TEXT, lease_until REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, baseline TEXT, pending_reaction TEXT, last_run TEXT, event_first REAL, event_last REAL, PRIMARY KEY(profile,name) )

CREATE TRIGGER api_artifact_validating AFTER UPDATE OF state ON processing_artifacts WHEN NEW.state='validating' BEGIN UPDATE api_requests SET state='validating' WHERE job_id=NEW.job_id AND state='running'; END

CREATE TRIGGER api_job_events AFTER UPDATE OF state ON processing_jobs WHEN NEW.state != OLD.state BEGIN INSERT INTO api_events(profile,resource_type,resource_id,state) VALUES(NEW.profile,'job',NEW.id,NEW.state); END

CREATE TRIGGER api_job_request_states AFTER UPDATE OF state ON processing_jobs BEGIN UPDATE api_requests SET state=CASE NEW.state WHEN 'complete' THEN 'ready' WHEN 'changed' THEN 'stale' WHEN 'timeout' THEN 'failed' ELSE NEW.state END WHERE job_id=NEW.id AND state NOT IN ('cancelled'); UPDATE api_requests SET reserved_bytes=0 WHERE job_id=NEW.id AND NEW.state IN ('complete','failed','timeout','changed','cancelled'); END

CREATE TRIGGER api_release_reservations AFTER UPDATE OF state ON processing_jobs WHEN NEW.state IN ('complete','failed','timeout','changed','cancelled') BEGIN DELETE FROM api_reservations WHERE job_id=NEW.id; END
CREATE TRIGGER api_request_created AFTER INSERT ON api_requests BEGIN INSERT INTO api_events(profile,resource_type,resource_id,state) VALUES(NEW.profile,'request',NEW.id,NEW.state); END

CREATE TRIGGER api_request_events AFTER UPDATE OF state ON api_requests WHEN NEW.state!=OLD.state BEGIN INSERT INTO api_events(profile,resource_type,resource_id,state) VALUES(NEW.profile,'request',NEW.id,NEW.state); END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_binding_claim_consistent BEFORE INSERT ON catalog_bindings WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_mutation_permits p JOIN catalog_state state ON state.id=1 WHERE p.scope_kind='version' AND p.scope_id=NEW.version_id AND p.incarnation=state.incarnation) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_versions v JOIN item_files a ON a.item_id=v.association_item_id WHERE v.id=NEW.version_id AND a.id=NEW.association_id AND a.role='primary' AND a.active=1) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'catalog_binding_owner_mismatch'); END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_binding_revision_association BEFORE INSERT ON catalog_binding_revisions WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_bindings b JOIN catalog_versions v ON v.id=b.version_id JOIN item_files a ON a.id=b.association_id WHERE b.id=NEW.binding_id AND a.item_id=v.association_item_id AND a.file_id=NEW.file_id AND a.part=NEW.part AND a.role='primary' AND a.active=1) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'catalog_binding_association_mismatch'); END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_binding_revisions_append BEFORE INSERT ON catalog_binding_revisions WHEN NEW.revision != COALESCE((SELECT MAX(revision) FROM catalog_binding_revisions WHERE binding_id=NEW.binding_id),0)+1 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_mutation_permits p JOIN catalog_state state ON state.id=1 WHERE p.scope_kind='version' AND p.scope_id=(SELECT version_id FROM catalog_bindings WHERE id=NEW.binding_id) AND p.incarnation=state.incarnation) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'catalog_revision_or_owner_conflict'); END
CREATE TRIGGER catalog_binding_revisions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON catalog_binding_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'catalog_history_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_binding_revisions_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON catalog_binding_revisions WHEN (NEW."binding_id" IS NOT NULL AND NEW."revision" IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "catalog_binding_revisions" existing WHERE existing."binding_id" IS NEW."binding_id" AND existing."revision" IS NEW."revision")) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'catalog_immutable_key_reuse'); END
CREATE TRIGGER catalog_binding_revisions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON catalog_binding_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'catalog_history_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_binding_revisions_uncommitted BEFORE INSERT ON catalog_binding_revisions WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_command_receipts r WHERE r.catalog_id=NEW.command_catalog_id AND r.host_namespace=NEW.command_host_namespace AND r.operation_id=NEW.command_operation_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'catalog_committed_history_sealed'); END
CREATE TRIGGER catalog_bindings_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON catalog_bindings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'catalog_history_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER catalog_bindings_no_replace BEFORE INSERT ON catalog_bindings WHEN (NEW."id" IS NOT NULL AND NEW."version_id" IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "catalog_bindings" existing WHERE existing."id" IS NEW."id" AND existing."version_id" IS NEW."version_id")) OR (NEW."association_id" IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "catalog_bindings" existing WHERE existing."association_id" IS NEW."association_id")) OR (NEW."id" IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "catalog_bindings" existing WHERE existing."id" IS NEW."id")) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'catalog_immutable_key_reuse'); END
CREATE TRIGGER catalog_bindings_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON catalog_bindings BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'catalog_history_immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER notification_job_events AFTER UPDATE OF state ON processing_jobs WHEN NEW.state != OLD.state AND NEW.state IN ('complete','failed','timeout') BEGIN INSERT INTO consumer_events(id,profile,event,severity,subject) VALUES('job:' || lower(hex(randomblob(16))), NEW.profile, CASE NEW.state WHEN 'complete' THEN 'job_completed' ELSE 'job_failed' END, CASE NEW.state WHEN 'complete' THEN 'info' ELSE 'error' END, NEW.id); INSERT INTO notification_deliveries(event_id,profile,destination_id) SELECT e.id, e.profile, d.id FROM consumer_events e JOIN notification_destinations d ON d.profile=e.profile WHERE e.rowid=last_insert_rowid() AND d.enabled=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(d.subscriptions) WHERE value=e.event) AND (e.severity='error' OR d.min_severity='info'); END

CREATE TRIGGER publication_source_version AFTER UPDATE OF size,mtime_ns,device,inode ON observations WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM remount_guard WHERE profile=NEW.profile) AND NEW.status='present' AND (OLD.size!=NEW.size OR OLD.mtime_ns!=NEW.mtime_ns OR OLD.device!=NEW.device OR OLD.inode!=NEW.inode) BEGIN INSERT INTO publication_generations(profile,catalog,local_binding,generation) SELECT DISTINCT profile,catalog,local_binding,1 FROM publication_source_paths WHERE profile=NEW.profile AND file_id=NEW.file_id ON CONFLICT(profile,catalog) DO UPDATE SET generation=publication_generations.generation+1,local_binding=excluded.local_binding; UPDATE consumer_bindings SET generation=generation+1,due_at=CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS REAL)+debounce,indexing=NULL WHERE profile=NEW.profile AND enabled=1 AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM publication_source_paths p WHERE p.profile=NEW.profile AND p.file_id=NEW.file_id AND p.catalog=consumer_bindings.catalog AND (consumer_bindings.subtree='' OR p.path=consumer_bindings.subtree OR substr(p.path,1,length(consumer_bindings.subtree)+1)=consumer_bindings.subtree||'/')); END

CREATE TRIGGER webhook_request_events AFTER UPDATE OF state ON api_requests WHEN NEW.state != OLD.state AND NEW.state IN ('ready','failed','cancelled','stale','blocked') BEGIN INSERT INTO consumer_events(id,profile,event,severity,subject) SELECT 'request:' || lower(hex(randomblob(16))), NEW.profile, 'request_' || NEW.state, CASE NEW.state WHEN 'failed' THEN 'error' ELSE 'info' END, NEW.id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM api_webhooks WHERE request_id=NEW.id); INSERT INTO notification_deliveries(event_id,profile,destination_id) SELECT e.id,e.profile,d.id FROM consumer_events e JOIN api_webhooks w ON w.request_id=NEW.id AND w.profile=e.profile JOIN notification_destinations d ON d.profile=w.profile AND d.id=w.destination_id WHERE e.rowid=last_insert_rowid() AND e.subject=NEW.id AND e.event='request_' || NEW.state AND d.enabled=1; END

CREATE VIEW catalog_active_binding_revisions AS SELECT v.id AS version_id,v.current_revision AS version_revision,v.association_item_id, v.segmentation_context_id,vr.timeline_id,vr.timeline_revision,t.edition_item_id,vr.state, b.id AS binding_id,b.association_id,br.revision AS binding_revision, br.profile,br.file_id,br.file_revision,br.part,br.source_kind, br.source_start_us,br.source_end_us,br.timeline_start_us,br.timeline_end_us FROM catalog_versions v JOIN catalog_version_revisions vr ON vr.version_id=v.id AND vr.revision=v.current_revision JOIN catalog_timelines t ON t.id=vr.timeline_id JOIN catalog_version_bindings m ON m.version_id=v.id AND m.version_revision=v.current_revision JOIN catalog_bindings b ON b.id=m.binding_id AND b.version_id=v.id JOIN catalog_binding_revisions br ON br.binding_id=b.id AND br.revision=m.binding_revision

CREATE VIEW catalog_effective_file_tags AS SELECT a.* FROM file_tags a WHERE a.active=1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM catalog_file_tag_suppressions s JOIN catalog_tag_suppression_revisions h ON h.subject_type=s.subject_type AND h.subject_id=s.file_id AND h.tag_id=s.tag_id AND h.revision=s.revision WHERE s.file_id=a.file_id AND s.tag_id=a.tag_id AND h.suppressed=1)

CREATE VIEW catalog_effective_item_tags AS SELECT a.* FROM item_tags a WHERE a.active=1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM catalog_item_tag_suppressions s JOIN catalog_tag_suppression_revisions h ON h.subject_type=s.subject_type AND h.subject_id=s.item_id AND h.tag_id=s.tag_id AND h.revision=s.revision WHERE s.item_id=a.item_id AND s.tag_id=a.tag_id AND h.suppressed=1)

CREATE VIEW catalog_legacy_association_classification AS SELECT a.association_id,a.original_file_id,a.original_item_id,a.original_row_json, CASE WHEN b.id IS NULL THEN 'unclassified' ELSE 'claimed' END AS classification, b.id AS binding_id,b.version_id, CASE WHEN live.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS legacy_row_present FROM catalog_legacy_associations a LEFT JOIN catalog_bindings b ON b.association_id=a.association_id LEFT JOIN item_files live ON live.id=a.association_id
CREATE VIEW catalog_live_binding_revisions AS SELECT b.* FROM catalog_active_binding_revisions b WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_version_retirements x WHERE x.version_id=b.version_id)

CREATE VIEW catalog_live_items AS SELECT i.* FROM items i WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_logical_retirements r WHERE r.item_id=i.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_versions v JOIN catalog_version_retirements r ON r.version_id=v.id WHERE v.association_item_id=i.id)
CREATE VIEW catalog_live_versions AS SELECT v.* FROM catalog_versions v WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM catalog_version_retirements x WHERE x.version_id=v.id)
CREATE VIEW catalog_logical_aliases AS SELECT item_id AS source_item_id,survivor_item_id FROM catalog_logical_retirements WHERE kind='merge'

CREATE VIEW publication_source_paths AS SELECT m.catalog,m.path,m.file_id,b.profile, json_object('profile',b.profile,'kind',b.kind,'owner',b.owner,'root',b.root,'device',b.device,'inode',b.inode) AS local_binding FROM mappings m JOIN bindings b ON b.kind='output' AND b.owner=m.catalog WHERE m.active=1 AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM owned_links o WHERE o.profile=b.profile AND o.catalog=m.catalog AND o.path=m.path) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM owned_hardlinks o WHERE o.profile=b.profile AND o.catalog=m.catalog AND o.path=m.path))
